conditions.headline: Leftover SSW swell, magnets stay 1-2ft OH, sheltered breaks drop off size. AM best, PM sea breeze
conditions.observation:
Some decent options in the morning with a bunch of Bukit reefs worth looking at on the incoming tide. Slack winds and relatively clean conditions for these zones, just be aware of a weaker leftover SW swell in the water - still playful and 1-2ft OH on outside corners but much smaller / less consistent at the less prominent breaks.
Make the most of the morning conditions, afternoon sea breeze will mean more wind affected options on the outer reefs

conditions.headline: Clean morning conditions, size an issue with protected zones very small. South swell mags best
conditions.observation:
Some morning options to eye off but you'll wanna chase some swell with outer edges of the Bukit and other swell exposures hovering around that chest-head high zone in the morning, slightly smaller again in the PM.
Get in early, AM winds standing out as a clean window to strike and PM a lot less reliable with swell magnets likely to lump up pretty quickly and sheltered zones verging on too small.
